name: carry-rules-edit
what: A new browser: on Evidence feeds' own page the owner handles a column the estate describes its own way, so the flow there is no longer the flow the estate reads
clicks: The feed names the authority, not the certificate’s issuer field

name: carry-rules-decides
what: The day decided there, under the rules as they are there

name: carry-rules-not-carried
what: The estate's page doesn't take it: the decision was made at a flow whose rules differ, by its hash. The day still waits here, and the sheet says what was decided there and why it isn't carried

.vf-detail .vf-not-carried: Decided on Evidence feeds’ page, where Evidence feeds isn’t as it is here: its rules differ, so that decision isn’t carried. Decide it here.
